description: Synthetic Levee Encroachments Dataset - Binary Segmentation (Unity Generated) is a data set deposited in IEEE DataPort by its authors Anav Katwal. "This dataset contains 800 synthetic RGB images (2000 x 2000 resolution) of levee encroachments for semantic segmentation along with binary segmentation masks (background vs encroachment). Both the images and masks were generated using Unity with structured domain randomization for camera and object positions and rotations. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and IEEE DataPort normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support water-network, drainage and hydraulic studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-ieeedp-repository.
